job: Tell the whole account something once, in a strip under the top bar.
purpose: A one-line strip across the page, under the top bar, for things that affect the account rather than one screen: a trial ending, a billing problem, a release. One line and one action. It can be dismissed, and with data-fd-dismiss-key the dismissal is remembered in localStorage.
useWhen: A fact applies to every screen: trial ends in 3 days, payment failed, maintenance tonight.
A product launch or release needs one announcing line at the top of the app.

avoidWhen.when: The message belongs to one section or one form.
The message is a hero moment with art and several actions.
Confirming an action that just happened.
More than one line of text or more than one action.

states.name: dismissed
states.how: data-fd-dismiss on a button; fires a cancelable fd:close, then sets hidden

states.name: remembered
states.how: data-fd-dismiss-key="name" stores the dismissal in localStorage

variants.useWhen: A launch line on an accent fill, with a solid badge.
A line that should not pull the eye.
A line set into the page.
An accent-tinted notice that is not a launch.
Text starts at the leading edge instead of the centre.
Text sits at the trailing edge.
Banner: something needs attention soon but is not broken.
Banner: something failed or is destructive.
Banner: something finished or is healthy.

keyboard.does: On the dismiss button, hides the banner.
